note: Each toolkit's ptxas (its .note.nv.tkinfo version, build and arguments, -v aside), every signature (sass_gate.signature) of each subroutine with a flagged instruction that it builds for ieee_pin.cu (ptxas specializes a body to its call sites, so one name may have several), and the numeric run (ieee_pin.py) that gated and ran those builds and found every sequence exact; a toolkit without one exempts nothing. Regenerate with: python sass_gate.py --pin BINARY... --toolkit NAME, ieee_pin.cu built with that toolkit with and without -fmad=false (POUW_CUDA_BIN naming its bin/); ieee_pin.py refuses to run when the entry isn't what its builds pin.
